note:

<tjsPlayerClass>
<tjsInfo:
Swordmasters live and die by the sword,
as warriors that specialize in western
swords such as longswords, broadswords,
and two-handed swords, as well as
fighting on the battlefield with a pair
of dual-wielded longswords (one longsword
in each hand).  They use Tactical Points
(TP) for special attacks, and have little
use for Magic Points (MP).  As they
progress in levels of experience, they
increasingly gain additional actions per
combat turn, allowing for multiple deadly
strike combinations against one or many
opponents.  They are strong and fast, and
can act quickly in combat, attacking
sooner in a combat turn than some other
characters.
>

name: Axemaster
note:
<tjsTraitsToHitPhysical:[175,100]>
<tjsTraitsToHitMagical:[-250,100]>
<tjsTraitsMagicFocus:[0,90]>
<tjsTraitsMagicFocusDebuff:200>

0.0025, 0.4000,-0.1625 ]>
<tjsActionsPerTurnBonus:[0]>
<tjsExpBase:1.0>
<tjsExpAdd:1.0>
<tjsPlayerClass>
<tjsInfo:
An Axemaster is much like a
swordmaster, but their thing is axes and
battleaxes of different types and
fighting styles.  Axes, in general, are
slower to attack with than swords, and
can't block as easily, but with a good
swing can cut deeper.  Axes are also less
accurate than swords, while doing more
damage.\\LB
    Axes have an increased chance of
striking with a critical hit.  Also,
when an axemaster makes a critical hit
with an axe, the weapon's damage
multiplier for a critical hit is much
larger than any other type of melee
weapon.  Two-handed battleaxes in
particular can do a lot of damage to
begin with, and inflict critical hits
that really hurt.
>

name: Cleric
note:
<tjsTraitsToHitPhysical:[50,100]>
<tjsTraitsToHitMagical:[250,100]>
<tjsTraitsMagicFocus:[0,100]>
<tjsTraitsMagicFocusDebuff:75>

<tjsActionsPerTurnBonus:[0]>
<tjsExpBase:0.8925>
<tjsExpAdd:0.8925>
<tjsPlayerClass>
<tjsInfo:
A Cleric is a religious spellcaster
that draws upon the guidance of his/her
diety and religion for casting spells
related to healing, curing diseases and
curses, and bringing defeated companions
back to life after they fall in combat.
Clerics are also good at fighting the
undead.\\LB
    Note that while being guided by a
divine being, a cleric's magic is cast
using the cleric's own magic of their
spirit.  Unlike a wizard or mage, a
cleric needs help from their diety that
they pray to in addition to their holy
book - which is also their spellbook of
sorts, to have their spells available to
use.  A cleric must also follow their
religion and their diety's values, and
always be subject to their diety's
guidance, teachings, and judgement.
>

<tjsInfo:
The Combat Mage, or simply Mage for
short, is a specialist spellcaster that
can only wield magics related to blasting
things and directly causing damage from
various magical elements, and not much
else aside from such combat magic, and
therefore has a limited number of spells
they can cast.  On the other hand, they
are very good at the spells they cast,
casting them better than a general wizard
would.
>

note:

<tjsExpAdd:1.091425>
<tjsPlayerClass>
<tjsInfo:
The wizard is a general all-purpose
spellcaster that doesn't specialize in
any specific type or sort of magic, but
at the same time doesn't excel or have
extreme skill in any type of magic
either.  Their advantage is that they
have a large number of spells to choose
from in their large and extensive
spellbooks, for nearly any occasion.
They have, and value, flexibility, having
arcane knowledge of all sorts of things
that are magical.
>

name: Martial Artist
note:
<tjsTraitsToHitPhysical:[300,100]>
<tjsTraitsToHitMagical:[-250,100]>
<tjsTraitsMagicFocus:[0,100]>
<tjsTraitsMagicFocusDebuff:100>
<tjsTraitsMaxTacticalPoints:[0,100]>
<tjsTraitsCriticalHitRate:[2,-2]>
<tjsTraitsCriticalEvadeRate:[5,-5]>
<tjsActionsPerTurnByLevel:[0]>
<tjsActionsPerTurnBonus:[0]>
<tjsExpBase:0.9725>
<tjsExpAdd:0.9725>
<tjsPlayerClass>
<tjsInfo:
The Martial Artist is skilled in
unarmed combat, knowing how to fight
without weapons, with a variety of
techniques and styles.  When equipped
with their handbooks, which have many
pages filled with vast exercises,
methods, kata, ethics, and much more to
study and practice, they have a number of
melee skills they can use, some of which
making use of the magic of their spirit
to make their attacks and techniques
far more effective than mundane methods
alone ever could.  This gives them
superhuman abilities to compete with
a swordmaster's sword, a rifleman's gun,
and an arcane spellcaster's combat magic
spells, as well as defeat enemies that
have body armor and other protection in
ways that mundane fighting arts would
never come close to.  Not favoring
weapons, their selection of weaponry and
how many they can equip at a time is not
the same as characters of other classes.
>

<tjsInfo:
The Kensei is a sword master or
"sword saint," and is a legendary
individual of the world they live in.
There is a maximum of only one Kensei in
any world.  A kensei has extreme skill
and expertise in all swords of all kinds,
and is very special.  Becoming a kensei
is a great honor that very few can ever
hope to qualify for.  A kensei is also a
legendary hero of outstanding
accomplishment, with qualities that are
unmatched and recognized by people of his
or her world.
>
